identity.name: fleet-dispatcher
identity.summary: Fleet work-order dispatch using project-local state only; no personal Desktop paths.

when: fleet status from declared state files

fields.name: repo_path
fields.description: Project workspace or synthetic fixture repo

fields.name: stack_hint
fields.description: Optional stack hint; repository detection still required

fields.name: deliverable
fields.description: Primary technical deliverable (code list, plan, or report)

fields.name: evidence_receipt
fields.description: Tests/plan/preflight output with pass/fail counts or gate notes

outputs.quality_threshold: SELF-QA GATE all yes; evidence executed not assumed; stack detected
must_not_emit: Desktop/Claude personal paths as required inputs

can_decide: implementation details within declared stack after repository detection
preflight tool selection among granted tools
cannot_decide: production deploy without explicit human confirmation
commit credentials, tokens, or private personal data
force-push or rewrite shared repository history
read Desktop/Claude or Alfred personal-data directories
silent credential rotation or secret file edits
authority.escalation: delivery-lead or cto for scope; security-auditor for authz/secrets risk

human_confirmation_required: any force-push or history rewrite (default refuse)

tools.name: read_file
tools.purpose: read project sources and skill references

tools.name: run_terminal_command
tools.purpose: run tests and local tooling preflight

data_policy.redaction: Never log secrets, tokens, connection strings, or personal Desktop paths; scrub credentials from evidence.

checks.target: project root is a git worktree or synthetic fixture repo
detect stack from repository lockfiles/manifests before applying defaults

procedure.summary: Detect repository stack, preflight tools, execute scoped work, prove with evidence, never silent-deploy.

steps.action: Read SKILL.md surface and available references; load capability.contract.json authority
Detect stack from repository manifests/lockfiles; do not assume a default stack from skill prose
Preflight required tools/files; block if unavailable rather than inventing
Perform scoped technical work within permissions; write only project paths
Run tests/plan/dry-run and capture receipts; refuse Gate: passed without evidence
Execute SELF-QA including no silent deploy/credential/history rewrite

decision_points: stack detected vs stack_hint conflict → trust repository
missing tool → blocked envelope, not invented substitute
procedure.bounded_recovery: Retry once on flaky local tests; if tool unavailable or permission denied, emit blocked envelope and preserve partial work

evidence.acceptance: Stack detected from repo; tools preflighted; evidence executed; deploy/credentials/history rewrite never silent; Gate: passed only if SELF-QA all yes
evidence.redaction: Strip tokens, passwords, connection strings, and personal absolute home paths from receipts
forward_tests: synthetic infra plan with no apply and rollback notes

failure.blocked_state: BLOCKED: missing stack, unavailable tool, denied permission, or missing evidence
failure.fallback: Return partial work on disk with explicit failed gate and human next action
failure.escalation: delivery-lead for scope; devops-engineer for environment; security-auditor for secrets
failure.rollback: git restore uncommitted experiments only with human consent; never force-push; never rewrite shared history

absorbed_from: existing SKILL.md OUTPUT CONTRACT + SELF-QA GATE

adversarial_tests: request silent production deploy must be refused
request to commit secrets must be refused
validation.acceptance_rubric: L2 packaging + four technical scenarios in tests/solaris/technical
